description: This file defines a Polymer behavior and related implementation for multi-selectable components, including properties, methods for selection toggling, and observers to manage selection state.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects or toggles selection of a given value based on whether multi-selection is enabled.

methods.name: multiChanged
methods.description: Observer method that updates internal selection state when the 'multi' property changes.

methods.name: _shouldUpdateSelection
methods.description: Getter that determines if the selection should be updated based on current selection properties.

methods.name: _updateSelected
methods.description: Updates selection state based on current property values, either multi or single selection.

methods.name: _selectMulti
methods.description: Selects multiple items based on an array of values.

methods.name: _selectionChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the selection object and updates the selected items accordingly.

methods.name: _toggleSelected
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of a given value in multi-select mode.
